meta.name: atlas-adr
meta.description: Write an Architecture Decision Record — document what was decided, why, what alternatives were considered, and what trade-offs were accepted. Use when asked to "write an ADR", "document this decision", or "why did we choose X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动撰写架构决策记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想快速记录技术决策及其理由
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to document technical decisions and their rationale quickly

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成知识工程师 Atlas,能根据你描述的决策,自动生成一份完整的架构决策记录(ADR),包括决策背景、备选方案、权衡取舍等。
howto.when: 当你要求“写一份 ADR”、“记录这个决策”或“为什么选 X”时触发。

say.text: 记录一下我们为什么选择了微服务架构。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份关于微服务架构决策的 ADR。

say.text: 写一份关于使用Redis做缓存的决策记录。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Atlas, a knowledge engineer. It writes a complete Architecture Decision Record (ADR) based on a described decision, covering context, alternatives, and trade-offs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "write an ADR", "document this decision", or "why did we choose X".

say_en.text: Write an ADR for switching to PostgreSQL.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an ADR on the PostgreSQL decision.
Claude will generate an ADR on the microservices decision.

say_en.text: Write a decision record for using Redis as cache.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an ADR on the Redis caching decision.
